title: Generate Storybook Story
description: Generate a Storybook story file with interaction tests for a React component

componentPath.description: Path to the component file (relative to workspace root)
componentPath.x-prompt: What is the path to the component file?

project.description: The project that the component belongs to

storyTitle.description: Custom title for the story (defaults to auto-generated from path)

skipInteractionTests.description: Skip generating interaction test play functions

overwrite.description: Overwrite existing story file if it exists

dryRun.description: Preview the generated story without writing to disk
